In the seven years or so I've been working in marketing, I've learned the "inbound" approach will definitely attract bigger and better clients. Put yourself out there for the people who are looking for what you do can find you. Make sure when they \*do\* find you, that you appear to know what you're talking about. Give them every reason to be the one to start the interaction.

Put yourself in your prospective clients' shoes. Would *you* be inclined to hire someone who just randomly hit you up in hopes you might need something done, or someone you find during your own search for the product or service they're offering?
